summary: Do not land 0a8d976 unchanged: three reproduced defects, including complete foreign-scope header substitution that bypasses the intended branch pin. Existing tests and real C integration pass but do not cover these cases.

security_concerns.title: Caller headers replace the registered lifecycle instead of retaining mandatory scope
security_concerns.description: For a callback exactly matching bridge A task/session/endpoint, inherited request rejects any x-recursant header, then the fallback retains every supplied header and adds known scope only if a name is absent. A complete internally consistent header set from registered B therefore replaces A. The C gateway has no callback context and sees valid B, so the claim that conflicting caller tags remain invalid for gateway rejection is false.
security_concerns.reproduction: Open separate A/B instances. Pin A to public frontier using a tool-bearing explicit baseline request (200). Request private alias with honest A headers (403). Pass the B instance headers as extra_headers through A.request with task-a/session-a/base_url matching A. Send returned request to C: 200, physical private dispatch under B.
security_concerns.impact_boundary: Wrong lifecycle attribution and intended branch continuity bypass within one authenticated project. Not a source-key leak or cross-project authentication escalation; reproducer already has B scope metadata. No overlapping middleware installation is needed: two independent instances suffice.
security_concerns.required_fix: Bind output to immutable registered task/session/branch/generation and explicitly detect foreign/conflicting caller tags. Preserve conflict as a gateway-rejectable condition rather than forwarding a self-consistent foreign scope. Do not rely on a plugin exception alone if Hermes swallows it. Add actual C pin-conflict regression.

security_concerns.location: deploy/hermes/context_adapter/gateway.py:125 and 137-142 (inherited dict conversion also at context_adapter/__init__.py:149)
security_concerns.title: Header conversion silently removes original duplicate occurrences
security_concerns.description: dict(extra_headers) accepts iterable pairs and retains only the last value for exactly repeated names. The new fallback emits this normalized set despite promising every original occurrence remains available for gateway rejection. Reproduced with conflicting and correct X-Recursant-generation pairs: two occurrences become one and conflicting-original disappears.
security_concerns.impact_boundary: Occurrence-integrity/wire-contract violation. Probe is Python middleware capture, not a separate demonstrated C privilege escalation. Input is a convertible header-pair container currently accepted by the bridge, not a non-convertible container covered by the documented exception limitation.
security_concerns.required_fix: Detect duplicate occurrences before lossy conversion and preserve or explicitly fence invalid attribution; add list-pair/multidict and case-variant duplicate regressions. Do not change the legacy Adapter to solve this bridge requirement.

logic_errors.title: Failed registration leaks an idle exporter worker
logic_errors.description: GatewayBridge opens its scope and starts a worker before install_gateway registers callbacks. If register_middleware or register_hook raises, installation propagates without closing the worker or returning an adapter. The idle daemon retains its bound target, credential and scope and waits indefinitely; caller has no returned handle to close. Later hook failures can additionally leave partial registrations.
logic_errors.reproduction: A fixture context whose register_middleware raises RuntimeError after successful loopback scope open. Compare threads before/after and join the new recursant-context-export thread: it remains idle/alive. Reviewer recovered the bound target only for cleanup.
logic_errors.required_fix: Make install failure cleanup exception-safe, terminate the owned worker on any registration failure, and handle partial registration rollback according to the supported plugin API. Test failure at each registration step, including no residual export thread.

import os, sys, json, threading, time, http.client
from unittest.mock import patch
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
sys.path[:0] = [os.environ.get('BRIDGE_REPO', '/home/aj/projects/recursant-v4-m3-hermes-gateway-bridge'), os.environ.get('BRIDGE_REPO', '/home/aj/projects/recursant-v4-m3-hermes-gateway-bridge') + '/tests/integration']
from deploy.hermes.context_adapter.gateway import install_gateway
from deploy.hermes.test_gateway_bridge import Fixture
from deploy.hermes.test_context_adapter import Context
results = {}
f = Fixture()
options = dict(enabled=True, endpoint=f.url, task_id='task', session_id='session', branch='main', source_key_env='TEST_SOURCE_KEY', content_enabled=True, timeout=0.15)
ids = dict(task_id='task', session_id='session', turn_id='turn', api_request_id='api', api_call_count=1, base_url=f.url, finish_reason='stop')
with patch.dict(os.environ, TEST_SOURCE_KEY='synthetic-source-only'):
    with patch('os.environ.get', side_effect=AssertionError('disabled read env')), patch('threading.Thread.start', side_effect=AssertionError('disabled starts worker')):
        c=Context(); assert install_gateway(c) is None and not c.middleware and not c.hooks
    results['disabled_no_env_no_thread_no_hooks']=True
    a = install_gateway(Context(), **options); f.seen.get(timeout=1)
    request={'extra_headers':[('X-Recursant-generation','conflicting-original'),('X-Recursant-generation',a.generation)]}
    headers=a.request(request,**ids)['request']['extra_headers']
    results['duplicate_same_case_headers']={'input_occurrences':2,'output_occurrences':sum(k.lower()=='x-recursant-generation' for k in headers),'conflicting_original_preserved':'conflicting-original' in str(headers)}
    # Fresh known invocation plus repeated and late callback captures.
    known=dict(ids,api_request_id='repeat')
    known_tags=a.request({},**known)['request']['extra_headers']
    a.response(**known,assistant_message=NS(content='first known'))
    first=f.seen.get(timeout=1)[2]['event']
    a.response(**known,assistant_message=NS(content='MUST_NOT_EXPORT_REPEAT'))
    invalid=f.seen.get(timeout=1)[2]['event']
    assert first['association']=='exact' and invalid['kind']=='invalidation' and invalid['attempt']==known_tags['X-Recursant-attempt']
    # A previous known invocation receives a callback from a different endpoint.
    late=dict(ids,api_request_id='late')
    a.request({},**late)
    a.response(**dict(late,base_url=f.url+'/wrong'),assistant_message=NS(content='MUST_NOT_EXPORT_FOREIGN_ENDPOINT'))
    # Drain any coalesced loss for the repeated callback before locating late invalidation.
    captured=[]
    for _ in range(3):
        e=f.seen.get(timeout=1)[2]['event']; captured.append(e)
        if e.get('api_request_id')=='late': break
    assert captured[-1]['kind']=='invalidation' and captured[-1]['api_request_id']=='late'
    assert all('text' not in e for e in captured)
    results['repeat_and_wrong_endpoint_callbacks']={'first_exact':True,'repeat_invalidated_actual_attempt':True,'wrong_endpoint_invalidated_not_exported':True}
    # Close during a never-released server stall, not relying on release for worker exit.
    f.entered.clear(); f.stall=True
    clean=dict(ids,api_request_id='stall'); a.request({},**clean); a.response(**clean,assistant_message=NS(content='bounded'))
    assert f.entered.wait(1)
    t=time.monotonic(); a.close(timeout=0); a.worker.join(1)
    results['blocked_export_close_without_release']={'worker_exited':not a.worker.is_alive(),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t}
    # Installation raises after creating an idle worker; no adapter is returned to caller.
    before=set(threading.enumerate())
    class FailingContext:
        def register_middleware(self,*args): raise RuntimeError('registration rejected')
    try: install_gateway(FailingContext(), **options)
    except RuntimeError: pass
    leaked=[t for t in threading.enumerate() if t not in before and t.name=='recursant-context-export']
    for t in leaked: t.join(.25)
    results['registration_failure']={'orphan_workers_alive':sum(t.is_alive() for t in leaked),'caller_received_adapter':False}
    # Reviewer cleanup only: recover worker target; otherwise it would idle forever.
    for t in leaked: t._target.__self__.close(timeout=1)
f.close()
if os.environ.get('RECURSANT_CONTEXT_BRIDGE_BIN'):
    import test_router
    from test_gateway_bridge_live import LiveBridgeTests
    from pathlib import Path
    test=LiveBridgeTests()
    with patch.object(test_router,'BIN',Path(os.environ['RECURSANT_CONTEXT_BRIDGE_BIN'])), patch.dict(os.environ,RC_TEST_SOURCE='synthetic-source-only'):
        with test_router.RouterTests.router(test,test.configure) as (port,sink):
            endpoint='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(port)+'/v1'
            def make(task,session): return install_gateway(Context(), enabled=True, endpoint=endpoint, task_id=task, session_id=session, branch='main', source_key_env='RC_TEST_SOURCE', content_enabled=True)
            a=make('task-a','session-a'); b=make('task-b','session-b')
            try:
                common=dict(turn_id='turn',api_request_id='api',api_call_count=1,base_url=endpoint,finish_reason='stop')
                def chat(body,tags):
                    c=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',port,timeout=3)
                    c.request('POST','/v1/chat/completions',json.dumps(body),headers=dict(tags,Authorization='Bearer local-test-key',**{'Content-Type':'application/json'}))
                    r=c.getresponse(); data=r.read(); status=r.status; c.close(); return status
                # Pin A to public using an unsupported tool-bearing request.
                initial=dict(model='baseline',max_tokens=128,messages=[dict(role='user',content='start A')],tools=[dict(type='function',function=dict(name='fixture',parameters=dict(type='object',properties={})))])
                tagged=a.request(initial,**dict(common,task_id='task-a',session_id='session-a',api_request_id='pin-a'))['request']
                pin_status=chat(initial,tagged['extra_headers'])
                assert pin_status==200
                private=dict(model='alias',max_tokens=128,messages=[dict(role='user',content='scope A request')])
                tagged=a.request(private,**dict(common,task_id='task-a',session_id='session-a',api_request_id='honest-a'))['request']
                honest_status=chat(private,tagged['extra_headers'])
                assert honest_status==403
                headers_b=b.request({},**dict(common,task_id='task-b',session_id='session-b'))['request']['extra_headers']
                original=dict(private,extra_headers=headers_b)
                rewritten=a.request(original,**dict(common,task_id='task-a',session_id='session-a'))['request']
                tags=rewritten.pop('extra_headers')
                c=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',port,timeout=3)
                c.request('POST','/v1/chat/completions',json.dumps(rewritten),headers=dict(tags,Authorization='Bearer local-test-key',**{'Content-Type':'application/json'}))
                r=c.getresponse(); answer=json.loads(r.read()); status=r.status; c.close()
                results['foreign_complete_scope_headers']={'callback_task':'task-a','emitted_task':tags['X-Recursant-task-id'],'emitted_generation_is_B':tags['X-Recursant-generation']==b.generation,'http_status':status,'honest_A_pin_conflict_status':honest_status,'initial_A_status':pin_status,'final_physical_model':sink.seen[-1][2]['model'],'physical_dispatches':len(sink.seen)}
            finally: a.close(); b.close()
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
